tokens.v: Bring her hand up into the crop from below, the pipette squeezed so one amber drop has just necked off the glass tip and hangs elongated mid-fall above her waiting fingertips, a second bead sheeting warm across the back of her hand. 85mm at f/2.8, camera at collarbone height angled up: the pipette tip and wet skin tack-sharp, her far cheek soft. A loose strand of hair blurs across the left edge, cut by it. AURELIA sits letterpress-debossed into the matte cream band, ink pressed into uncoated fibre, shadow pooling in the impression as the band curves away. Fine-gauge charcoal ribbed tank. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
